## Welcome To Aokai Environtec

ABOUT USDirect Manufacturer
ABOUT US

Aokai Environtec, founded in 2004, Aokai is a factory-direct dust filter bag manufacturer providing
custom filter bags, needle-punched filter cloth and filter cages. We focus on **product
innovation**, **service innovation**, and **value innovation**, delivering integrated solutions to
our clients.

With over 300 skilled workers, German production techniques, rigorous material selection, imported
equipment, and advanced management systems, we achieve an annual output of **4,000,000 square
meters** of filter cloth, **4,000,000** filter bags, and **2,000,000** filter cages.

We have earned an excellent reputation from more than 10,000 customers worldwide thanks to our
superior quality, competitive pricing, professional consulting services, and extensive market
presence.

## [More Vacuum Cleaner Manufacturers][84]


### Industrial Vacuum Cleaner Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare industrial vacuum cleaner manufacturers that supply industrial vacuum, commercial
vacuum, and heavy duty commercial vacuum cleaner solutions for manufacturing, woodworking,
metalworking, food processing, pharmaceuticals, electronics, healthcare, construction, and building
maintenance. This directory helps buyers browse vacuum companies, source equipment by application,
and connect with a vacuum cleaning system supplier, vacuum cleaner factory, or vacuum cleaner
manufacturer corporation suited to demanding facility needs. Whether you need wholesale vacuum
cleaners, commercial vacuum cleaners for sale, or custom systems for the vacuum industry, use this
page to compare capabilities, filtration options, safety features, and supplier specialization.

### Industrial Vacuum Applications and Facility Use Cases

Industrial vacuum cleaners remove dust, chips, powders, liquids, fumes, and debris from production
floors, workshops, warehouses, and processing areas where standard cleaning equipment cannot handle
volume or hazard levels. A heavy duty commercial vacuum cleaner supports custodial crews, plant
maintenance teams, contractors, and facility managers that need stronger suction, larger collection
capacity, and durable construction for daily use. These systems are used in manufacturing,
construction, automotive service, woodworking, metal fabrication, food processing, and institutional
cleaning where air quality, housekeeping, and worker safety all matter.

### Central Vacuum Systems for Industrial Facilities

Central vacuum systems provide permanent cleaning infrastructure for large plants, commercial
buildings, laboratories, hospitals, hotels, and processing facilities. Instead of moving a full unit
from area to area, workers connect hoses to fixed inlets while debris moves through piping to a
remote collection point. This arrangement supports higher throughput, lower workspace noise, easier
disposal, and efficient cleaning across multiple departments or production zones.

### Industrial Vacuum Cleaner Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare industrial vacuum cleaner manufacturers that supply industrial vacuum, commercial
vacuum, and heavy duty commercial vacuum cleaner solutions for manufacturing, woodworking,
metalworking, food processing, pharmaceuticals, electronics, healthcare, construction, and building
maintenance. This directory helps buyers browse vacuum companies, source equipment by application,
and connect with a vacuum cleaning system supplier, vacuum cleaner factory, or vacuum cleaner
manufacturer corporation suited to demanding facility needs. Whether you need wholesale vacuum
cleaners, commercial vacuum cleaners for sale, or custom systems for the vacuum industry, use this
page to compare capabilities, filtration options, safety features, and supplier specialization.

### Industrial Vacuum Applications and Facility Use Cases

Industrial vacuum cleaners remove dust, chips, powders, liquids, fumes, and debris from production
floors, workshops, warehouses, and processing areas where standard cleaning equipment cannot handle
volume or hazard levels. A heavy duty commercial vacuum cleaner supports custodial crews, plant
maintenance teams, contractors, and facility managers that need stronger suction, larger collection
capacity, and durable construction for daily use. These systems are used in manufacturing,
construction, automotive service, woodworking, metal fabrication, food processing, and institutional
cleaning where air quality, housekeeping, and worker safety all matter.

### Central Vacuum Systems for Industrial Facilities

Central vacuum systems provide permanent cleaning infrastructure for large plants, commercial
buildings, laboratories, hospitals, hotels, and processing facilities. Instead of moving a full unit
from area to area, workers connect hoses to fixed inlets while debris moves through piping to a
remote collection point. This arrangement supports higher throughput, lower workspace noise, easier
disposal, and efficient cleaning across multiple departments or production zones.
